Bengaluru Daycare Staff Face FIR Over Alleged Toddler Abuse

An FIR has been filed against five women working at a daycare center on an IT company campus in Bengaluru following allegations of physical abuse and cruelty towards toddlers. Disturbing videos reportedly surfaced showing caregivers mistreating children aged two to three, with accusations including locking them in bathrooms and placing them in a washing machine. The incident has prompted widespread concern and investigation into the alleged mistreatment.
